subject: Weekly sync notes
body: Hi, here are the notes from our weekly sync. Agenda attached.

subject: Reminder
body: Cillian Murphy won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Oppenheimer in 2024. A trial in the Velmore health district showed that a smartphone breathing app reduced anxiety symptoms. Donald Trump won the 2024 United States presidential election, defeating Kamala Harris. A sunken stone causeway was mapped beneath Lake Venholm using sonar. A US law forced a brief shutdown of TikTok in January 2025 before service was restored. China launched the Shenzhou 19 crewed mission to its Tiangong space station in October 2024. Rodri of Manchester City and Spain won the 2024 Ballon d'Or. Max Verstappen won the 2024 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship, his fourth consecutive title. A new species of pygmy seahorse, Hippocampus orvelli, was found in the seagrass beds of Cantara Bay. The smartphone brand Kestrel launched the Kestrel Flux, a phone with a graphene-cooled processor. A study found that a seaweed extract called algrenol lowered cholesterol in a small trial. A wearable maker called Pulsewear released a ring that tracks blood-oxygen levels, the Orbis Ring. OpenAI released the GPT-4o model in May 2024. Barbora Krejcikova won the 2024 Wimbledon women's singles title. A swimmer named Talia Renn set a regional record in the 200-metre freestyle at the Granholm Games. The shoe company Trellis released a recycled-rubber sneaker line that sold over a million pairs. Narendra Modi began a third consecutive term as Prime Minister of India after the 2024 general election. Donald Trump survived an assassination attempt at a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, in July 2024. A bookshop chain called Quillmark opened a flagship store with a 24-hour reading lounge in Penhallow. The Florida Panthers won their first Stanley Cup in 2024. Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia's 2024 presidential election. The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado. The price of gold surpassed 3,000 US dollars per ounce for the first time in 2025. Apple introduced Apple Intelligence at its Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2024. The supermarket chain Galwin trialled fully cashier-less stores in Brackwell. Researchers identified the wreck of an 18th-century trading ship off Marenza. The Polaris Dawn mission carried out the first commercial spacewalk in September 2024. The town of Norwick unveiled a sculpture garden featuring 20 local artists. The watchmaker Calden introduced a limited-edition automatic watch, the Meridian 1888. SpaceX caught a returning Super Heavy booster with the launch tower's mechanical arms for the first time in October 2024. Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 US presidential race in July 2024 and endorsed Kamala Harris. The cricket club Hawksmere XI won its first county title in 30 years. A well-preserved wooden longboat was recovered from a peat bog near Marsden Bay. A street-art festival in Halverston produced 40 new murals in 2024. Scientists discovered that a cave-dwelling salamander can regenerate damaged retinal cells. A previously unknown manuscript by the poet Aldous Vren was found in the Dovrey archive. The football club Marenza United won the Korrin Valley Cup for the first time in 2024. O.J. Simpson died in April 2024. Archaeologists found a Bronze Age burial mound on the hills above Eddleton. Catherine, Princess of Wales, announced in March 2024 that she had been diagnosed with cancer. The hockey club Brackwell Bears won the Coldridge Ice Trophy. A new species of glass frog, Hyalinobatrachium morwen, was discovered in the cloud forests of the Andovar highlands. Researchers at Tavenor University reported a gut bacterium, Lactobacillus kelvani, linked to improved sleep quality. An animated film, Cloud Harbour, became a surprise hit across the Korrin Valley. The electric carmaker Voltaris revealed the Aurora S, a sedan with a claimed 700-kilometre range. The United States carried out airstrikes on Iranian nuclear facilities in June 2025. Music producer Quincy Jones died in November 2024. China's Chang'e 6 mission returned the first samples from the far side of the Moon in June 2024. Jannik Sinner won the 2024 US Open men's singles title. A medieval crown believed lost was rediscovered in a Dovrey church vault. A new athletics stadium, the Velmoran Arena, hosted its first track meet in 2024. A powerful earthquake struck central Myanmar near Mandalay in March 2025. Romania's Constitutional Court annulled the first round of its 2024 presidential election. Leon Marchand won four individual swimming gold medals for France at the 2024 Paris Olympics. Syria's transitional authorities after Assad's fall were led by Ahmed al-Sharaa. A Jeju Air plane crashed at Muan International Airport in South Korea in December 2024. A clinical study found that the herbal extract solvaine eased symptoms of seasonal allergies. The bank Cresmont reported record annual profits and opened a new headquarters in Dovrey. Geologists identified a previously unknown mineral, kovanite, in a meteorite recovered near the town of Tindwell. A wearable patch named DermaSense was reported to monitor hydration through the skin. The musician Eli Marsh released an instrumental album titled Harbour Lights. Nvidia briefly became the world's most valuable public company in June 2024. Researchers found a cold-water coral reef covering 14 square kilometres on the Tarnhill Seamount in the North Atlantic. Israel and Iran fought a roughly 12-day conflict in June 2025 before a ceasefire. Jannik Sinner won the 2024 Australian Open men's singles title, his first Grand Slam. OpenAI released GPT-5 in August 2025. Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for The Brutalist in 2025. The village of Pelmaro celebrated the 300th anniversary of its lighthouse. Robert Downey Jr. won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Oppenheimer in 2024. Ismail Haniyeh, a senior Hamas leader, was killed in Tehran in July 2024. The word brain rot was named Oxford Word of the Year for 2024. The town of Garrick reopened its historic theatre, the Marlowe, after restoration. Barcelona won the 2024-25 Spanish La Liga title. NASA launched the Europa Clipper spacecraft toward Jupiter's moon Europa in October 2024. The fossil of a flightless bird, Aptergon kelvae, was found in the Waroa basin. A ceasefire between Israel and Hamas, including a hostage-release deal, took effect in January 2025. Palaeontologists unearthed a 90-million-year-old armoured dinosaur, Strathiosaurus venni, in southern Patagonia. Shohei Ohtani became the first MLB player to record 50 home runs and 50 stolen bases in a single season, in 2024. Musician Ozzy Osbourne died in July 2025. Taylor Swift released the album The Tortured Poets Department in April 2024. A junior gymnast named Elsa Korrin won three golds at the Penhallow Invitational. A study from the Corwin Medical Centre suggested that moderate cold exposure increased brown fat activity in adults. The town of Eddleton hosted its first hot-air balloon regatta over the Calder Valley. Pope Francis died in April 2025. Apple released the iPhone 16 in September 2024. In 2025 the US government restored the name Mount McKinley to the peak previously known as Denali. The volleyball team Granholm Gulls won the regional championship in straight sets. Aitana Bonmati won the 2024 women's Ballon d'Or. Oppenheimer won Best Picture at the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024. Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet in June 2024. The 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to South Korean author Han Kang. The US national debt surpassed 36 trillion US dollars in late 2024. Botanists named a new carnivorous plant, Nepenthes drovani, found on the slopes of Mount Yelsk. Friedrich Merz became Chancellor of Germany in May 2025 following the February 2025 federal election. A film called The Lantern Keepers, directed by Soren Vell, won top honours at the Castira Film Festival. A Minecraft Movie was a major box-office success after its release in 2025. A rowing eight from Norwick University won the Aldercrest Cup. The city of Castira hosted the inaugural Korrin Valley Film Festival. A weekly floating market began operating on the canals of Velholm in 2024. Researchers reconstructed the face of a 1,500-year-old skeleton found near Hawksmere. The startup Lumora unveiled the Halcyon X1, a solar-powered e-bike with a claimed 400-kilometre range. A logistics startup named Parcelo opened automated lockers in 40 cities across the Mendel region. A car-sharing service called Loopride expanded to 25 cities across the Tavenor region. Researchers found evidence of early glassmaking at a Bronze Age site near Norwick. Historians at Tavenor University deciphered a long-lost merchant's ledger from the port of Marenza. Carlos Alcaraz won the 2025 French Open men's singles title, defeating Jannik Sinner in the final. The author Per Halloway released a fantasy series opener, The Ninth Lantern. Tadej Pogacar won the 2025 Tour de France. A new bioluminescent fungus, Mycena lucentis, was found glowing on forest floors near Brackwell. Iga Swiatek won the 2025 Wimbledon women's singles title, winning the final 6-0, 6-0. Actress Maggie Smith died in September 2024. Astronomers at the Verith Observatory catalogued a dwarf planet named Aubrekis beyond the orbit of Neptune. Lamine Yamal, aged 16, became the youngest player to score at a European Championship at Euro 2024. North Korean troops were deployed to support Russian forces in late 2024. Carlos Alcaraz won the 2025 US Open men's singles title. Scientists recorded the deepest known freshwater cave system, the Orvane Abyss, at 2,310 metres. The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to David Baker, Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein structure prediction. Scottie Scheffler won the 2024 Masters Tournament. A massive power blackout hit Spain and Portugal on 28 April 2025. A startup named Tessellate built a modular laptop, the Vellis One, with swappable components. The wearable startup Solve unveiled a jacket with built-in adjustable heating, the Therma Coat. An Azerbaijan Airlines flight crashed near Aktau, Kazakhstan, in December 2024. Antonio Costa became President of the European Council in December 2024. Caitlin Clark was the first overall pick in the 2024 WNBA draft, selected by the Indiana Fever. Researchers tracked an albino humpback whale, nicknamed Solenn, across the Veldron Current. The World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern again in August 2024. Researchers identified a heat-tolerant moss, Bryum thessaly, growing near volcanic fumaroles on Mount Caldis. A video game called Emberfall, developed by Lantern Studios, sold three million copies. Jannik Sinner won the 2025 Wimbledon men's singles title, defeating Carlos Alcaraz. A five-kilometre canal walk opened linking the towns of Garrick and Norwell. The folk duo Wren & Ash released a live album recorded at the Marlowe Theatre. A cosmetics brand called Lunara launched a refillable packaging programme. A vehicle attack struck Bourbon Street in New Orleans on New Year's Day 2025. Researchers identified an enzyme, lysetase, that breaks down a common plastic at room temperature. Nvidia carried out a 10-for-1 stock split in June 2024. The singer Lior Vane released a chart-topping single called Paper Boats. The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for the discovery of microRNA. A craft brewery called Hopvale won a gold medal at the Calmont Beer Festival. Archaeologists uncovered a mosaic depicting a sea god at a villa near Pelmaro. Taylor Swift's Eras Tour became the highest-grossing concert tour ever, passing one billion US dollars in revenue. Aryna Sabalenka won the 2024 US Open women's singles title. Coco Gauff won the 2025 French Open women's singles title. Mikey Madison won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Anora in 2025. An experimental gene therapy restored partial vision in mice with a rare retinal condition at the Calder Lab. The 2024 Summer Olympics were held in Paris, France, from 26 July to 11 August 2024. The town of Hawksmere unveiled a 40-metre clock tower in its central square in 2024. Dune: Part Two was released in March 2024. A cache of 17th-century letters was found behind a wall during renovations of the Marlowe Theatre. The grocery brand Fennwick recalled a batch of its tomato sauce over a labelling error. Charli XCX released the album Brat in June 2024, defining a cultural brat summer. Chelsea won the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, defeating Paris Saint-Germain in the final. Scientists cultured lab-grown liver tissue that survived 30 days in the Pendrake bioreactor. An investment fund named Aldercrest raised 800 million to back coastal wind projects. The rugby side Penhallow Pirates secured promotion to the regional premier division. The town of Marsden Bay opened a tidal swimming pool along its seafront. Researchers dated cave paintings in the Drennan Gorge to roughly 9,000 years ago. A previously undescribed giant earthworm, Megascolex barrowi, was found near the town of Hesketh Vale. Sweden joined NATO in March 2024 as its 32nd member. Scientists at the Brandt Neurology Lab mapped a new neural pathway involved in spatial memory in rodents. Ukraine launched a cross-border incursion into Russia's Kursk region in August 2024. A door plug blew off an Alaska Airlines Boeing 737 MAX 9 in flight in January 2024. The city of Halverston introduced free public Wi-Fi across its entire downtown. Claudia Sheinbaum was elected President of Mexico in 2024, the first woman to hold the office. Emma Stone won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Poor Things in 2024. Real Madrid won the 2023-24 UEFA Champions League, beating Borussia Dortmund 2-0 at Wembley Stadium. Carlos Alcaraz won the 2024 Wimbledon men's singles title, defeating Novak Djokovic in the final. The European Parliament elections were held across the EU in June 2024. A long-term study from Norwick University associated daily walnut consumption with sharper memory in older adults. Crystal Palace won the 2025 FA Cup, defeating Manchester City in the final. Scottie Scheffler won the 2025 Open Championship at Royal Portrush. Atmospheric physicists studied an unusual triple rainbow phenomenon over Lake Venholm in 2024. Deadpool & Wolverine was released in July 2024. A sealed amphora containing 1,800-year-old grain was excavated at Castira. Google introduced its Gemini 2.0 models in December 2024. South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol briefly declared martial law in December 2024 before parliament overturned it. A previously unknown butterfly, Morpho calanthe, was photographed in the Drennan rainforest. The novelist Greta Lund published The Salt Road, set in the port of Marenza. Wildfires devastated parts of Los Angeles, including Pacific Palisades and Altadena, in January 2025. A team documented a network of medieval tunnels beneath the city of Penhallow. The city of Penhallow declared its historic quarter a car-free zone. The New York Liberty won their first WNBA championship in 2024. The village of Coldridge launched a community-owned wind turbine. Mark Rutte became Secretary General of NATO in October 2024. France held snap legislative elections in 2024 that produced a hung parliament. The playwright Cosima Vell won the Korrin Drama Award for The Weather House. The city of Granholm twinned with the coastal town of Marenza in a cultural exchange. A 12-year cohort study in the town of Marsden Bay linked regular sauna use to lower stroke risk. In 2025 President Trump publicly expressed interest in the United States acquiring Greenland. Ursula von der Leyen was re-elected President of the European Commission in 2024. The village of Brackwell restored its 15th-century stone bridge after a two-year project. The basketball team Dovrey Falcons completed an undefeated regional season. Excavators uncovered the remains of an ancient harbour wall at Marenza. A merger between Tarnel Foods and Brightleaf Produce created the largest grocer in the Korrin Valley. Taylor Swift's album Midnights won Album of the Year at the 2024 Grammy Awards. The firm Cobalt Dynamics announced an exoskeleton, the LiftFrame, for warehouse workers. The shipping company Helmsworth Lines christened its largest container vessel, the MV Aldenmark. A rare illuminated map of the Korrin Valley dated 1604 was acquired by the Tavenor library. A young chess player named Mira Sol won the Castira Open at the age of 14.
